items.title: Daryl Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2024
items.q: it’s meeting people and bonding in some cases... I got to go to England and started performing at Pizza on the Park in London, which was a place that Blossom Dearie played in

ctx.x: You know you answered a question of mine, I was going to ask in your memory what comes through as one of your best gigs ever and one of your worst gigs ever? So you did talk about, “Who’s this Daryl person that’s going to play Dave’s piano.” And then you just mentioned that wonderful gig so I think you answered the question — I didn’t even ask it.

Wow. No but I’ve had steady jobs, anonymous type jobs in restaurants where I would meet — ooh sorry — it’s meeting people and bonding in some cases. They become like best friends or kind of like family, and even traveling I got to go to England and started performing at Pizza on the Park in London, which was a place that Blossom Dearie played in and Dave Frishberg and lots of jazz people, some singers, and the ownership of that, let’s say the circle of places became The Pizza Express Live and they have a couple…
